claim_guard: This method was designed after inspection of earlier target outcomes and is restricted to method development. A favorable result can justify a full frozen portfolio run and later independent confirmation, but cannot itself establish a new cross-domain OOD claim.
hypothesis: Mechanism-eligible donor bundles improve recipient OOD prediction more reliably when donor features are cross-fitted by material identity, donors explain target-only residuals, and grouped pseudo-OOD validation can set the total transfer contribution exactly to zero.

source_rules.sentinel: the frozen wrong source is scored but cannot enter the final stack

stack.correction: ridge regression on target-only out-of-fold residuals

evaluation.required_escalation_pattern: positive mean Q4 gain, positive Q4-minus-Q1 specificity, positive Q4 R2, and no material advantage for the wrong-source sentinel
